title: Coherent-State Kernels for Composite Quantum Operations
summary: This paper develops a unified kernel-based method for computing exact matrix elements of composite quantum operations by inserting resolutions of the identity after individual operators or between successive factors of an operator chain. A single insertion gives an exact scalar identity, and nested insertions between the factors give multiple integral identities for chains of closed operators under explicit Bochner-integrability conditions.
